message.content:
Owners looking to convert an independent **upper-upscale** hotel in the Caribbean and Latin America most commonly consider **soft brands and upper-upscale flags** from the major chains, especially **Marriott**, **Hilton**, **Hyatt**, **IHG**, **Wyndham**, **Accor**, and **Choice/Radisson**.[2][9][13][15][16][17]

The brands most often cited for this kind of conversion opportunity include:

- **Marriott**: **Autograph Collection**, **Tribute Portfolio**, **Delta Hotels**, **Westin**, **Sheraton**, **Le Méridien**, and in some regional all-inclusive cases **The Luxury Collection**.[2][8][11][13]
- **Hilton**: **Curio Collection**, **Canopy by Hilton**, **Tapestry Collection**, and **Embassy Suites by Hilton**.[13][17]
- **Hyatt**: **Unbound Collection**, **Hyatt Centric**, **Hyatt Regency**, **Thompson Hotels**, and the newer **Unscripted by Hyatt** soft brand for independent upscale conversions.[15][17]
- **IHG**: **Voco**, **Kimpton**, **InterContinental**, **Six Senses**, **Regent**, and **Hotel Indigo**.[9][10][16][17]
- **Wyndham**: **Wyndham Grand**, **Dolce by Wyndham**, **Trademark Collection**, and in resort markets **Wyndham Alltra** for all-inclusive conversions.[1][18][19]
- **Choice / Radisson**: **Radisson Blu**, **Radisson Individuals**, **Ascend Hotel Collection**, and related upscale flags.[5][13][17]
- **Accor**: **Pullman**, **Swissôtel**, **MGallery**, and **Mövenpick**.[13][17]

In the Caribbean and Latin America specifically, the strongest conversion stories in the sources are **Marriott’s Autograph Collection**, **IHG’s Voco/Kimpton**, **Hyatt’s Unbound Collection**, and **Wyndham Alltra** for resort conversions.[1][8][9][11][15]

If you want, I can also narrow this to the **best-fit brands by asset type**—for example, *urban full-service*, *resort*, or *all-inclusive*.
